اجلعبا (form IVq)
# اِجْلَعَبَّا (ijlaʕabbā) /id͡ʒ.la.ʕab.baː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِجْلَعَبَّ (ijlaʕabba)
# اِجْلَعِبَّا (ijlaʕibbā) /id͡ʒ.la.ʕib.baː/: second-person dual imperative of اِجْلَعَبَّ (ijlaʕabba)
